help.topic: Provides various compression and encryption based file utilities.
Compresses one or more source files into a proprietary archive file using either the gzip or brotli algorithms.
One or more source files to add to the compression archive.
Path used when creating the output file.
Compute and display the sha-256 of the output file.
The compression algorithm to use, can be either gzip or brotli.
Split size, in kb, to optimize the output file.
Maximum time to allow for the operation.
Verbosity of output logging (trace, debug, or info).
